title: Tenure-Track, Open Rank Faculty in Data Analytics
description:
The University of North Alabama’s Department of Finance, Economics, and Data Analytics invites applications for an open-rank, tenure-track faculty position in data analytics beginning in fall 2027. This nine-month appointment in the Sanders College of Business & Technology includes full benefits and a salary competitive with other AACSB-accredited institutions. Application review begins immediately and continues until the position has been filled.  Sponsorship is not available for this position.  

Responsibilities include teaching undergraduate and graduate courses, both in person and online; advising students; conducting research consistent with AACSB accreditation standards; and providing professional and university service, including dissertation committee service as needed. The successful candidate must demonstrate proficiency in teaching introductory statistics or upper-level data analytics and a commitment to working with students from a range of backgrounds, engaging with student groups, and participating in experiential learning opportunities.  Faculty must maintain office hours in accordance with university policy and perform other duties as assigned. Candidates will be evaluated on teaching effectiveness and research productivity, including potential in both areas.

A doctorate in statistics, economics, data analytics, or a related field from an accredited university is required. ABD candidates will be considered, provided the degree requirements will be met by the start date of the appointment. A dissertation defense schedule must be provided upon request.

View the complete job description and apply through our Online Employment System at https://www.schooljobs.com/careers/una/jobs/5507820/tenure-track-assistant-associate-professor-of-data-analytics. Applications are accepted only through this system and must include a cover letter, resume/CV, transcripts, and contact information, including email addresses, for at least three professional or academic references.

Unofficial transcripts are accepted for application review. Submit transcripts for your highest degree and any additional degrees containing graduate coursework relevant to the teaching discipline. Upload copies under the “Unofficial Transcript” attachment headings. If electronic copies are unavailable, mail transcripts to Human Resources, One Harrison Plaza, UNA Box 5043, Florence, AL 35632, or deliver them to 601 Cramer Way, Room 226.

The successful candidate must provide official transcripts for the highest degree earned, sent directly from the issuing institution to HR by email or postal mail. Transcripts issued to the student are not considered official. UNA graduates may request transcripts at no charge using the online transcript request form; HR will upload them to the application.

For assistance, contact employment@una.edu or call 256-765-4291, option 2, for a timely response.

UNA is an equal opportunity employer. We seek a wide range of applicants for our positions so that our core values will be affirmed.
